worked.problem: Complete the square for f(x) = x² + 6x + 6 and state its turning point.
actions: Half the coefficient of x: 6 ÷ 2 = 3. The square will use (x + 3).
Square the half-coefficient: (3)² = 9. Add and subtract this amount.
The square is smallest when x = -3, so the turning point is (-3; -3).
Answer: (-3; -3). Expand (x + 3)² − 3 to recover x² + 6x + 6.
